title: MSFS 2024: Darwin Looks INCREDIBLE! 🇦🇺 | World Update 21 Australia First Look
description:
Darwin has finally received a much-needed facelift in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024! As the capital of Australia's Northern Territory, Darwin is famous for its stunning coastline and vast desert landscapes—and in World Update 21, the photogrammetry really brings it to life.  

In this video, we take a tour of the city and airport, checking out the updated textures and that famous tropical water color. We also look at:

- The Scenery: Detailed city buildings and the contrast between the desert and the coast.
- The Bugs: Are the ships still underwater? (Spoiler: Yes, they are!)

Is Darwin the best-looking city in the new Australia update? Let me know what you think of the water masking and the city detail in the comments!
